prefabMaterialRemapper.title: Prefab Material Remapper
prefabMaterialRemapper.copy: A Unity editor tool that remaps materials inside Prefab Assets by using the current Material.name in each slot as the matching key. It brings an FBX-style material remapping workflow to Prefab Assets.

cards.title: Best For
cards.body: Complex prefabs, VRChat outfit prefabs, and assets with repeated dummy material slot names across many renderers.

cards.title: Name-Based Mapping
cards.body: Uses the current Material.name in each slot as the grouping key, so every slot with the same name can be replaced in one pass.

cards.title: Safe Prefab Editing
cards.body: Uses LoadPrefabContents / SaveAsPrefabAsset to edit the original Prefab Asset safely instead of touching only a scene instance.

cards.title: Editor Only
cards.body: This is an editor-only prefab editing tool. It is intended for asset cleanup and material remapping before runtime, not for in-game material switching.

meta.body: Designed for Unity 2022.3+ and Prefab Assets that contain Renderer or SkinnedMeshRenderer material slots inside the Project window.

image.alt: Prefab Material Remapper English UI screenshot
image.caption: Assign a Prefab Asset, scan its slot keys, then map each key to the real material you want to apply.

sections.title: Key Features
items: Uses the current Material.name as a remapping key and groups all matching slots together.
Provides an FBX-style remapping workflow for Prefab Assets.
Scans every child Renderer inside the Prefab automatically.
Supports both MeshRenderer and SkinnedMeshRenderer.
Shows how many material slots each key affects.
Supports drag and drop from the Project window.
Editor-only workflow with no runtime impact.

sections.title: Requirements
items: Unity 2022.3 or newer
A Prefab Asset in the Project window
Renderer or SkinnedMeshRenderer components with assigned materials
Editor-only usage
No extra VPM dependency

sections.title: Basic Usage
items: Open Studio Iyan > Tools > Prefab Material Remapper.
Assign a Prefab Asset from the Project window or drag and drop it into the tool.
Click Scan Slots to build a key list from the current material names.
Assign the real replacement material next to each key.
Click Apply to Prefab Asset to replace every slot with the same key name.

entries.title: Prefab Asset / Drag and Drop
entries.body: You must assign the original Prefab Asset from the Project window. Scene instances and regular GameObjects are not valid targets.

entries.title: Scan Slots
entries.body: Loads the Prefab contents, scans all child Renderer sharedMaterials, and builds a key list using the current material names.

entries.title: Key / Count / Material Field
entries.body: The key is the current Material.name, the count shows how many slots use that key, and the material field is where you assign the actual replacement material.

entries.title: Apply to Prefab Asset
entries.body: Saves the configured material remapping into the Prefab Asset. Any key left empty is ignored during the apply step.

sections.title: Tips
items: It is best to preserve dummy material names from imported FBX assets if you want stable remapping later.
Names like `Metal`, `Body`, `Glass`, or `UV1` make large remap jobs much easier to manage.
After replacing a dummy material, the key may change to the new real material name, so keeping a backup of the original dummy-material structure is useful.
Because this edits the Prefab Asset directly, using Git or a backup before large remaps is a good idea.

entries.title: The Prefab Asset shows an error
entries.body: Make sure the target is an actual Prefab Asset from the Project window. Scene instances and ordinary GameObjects are not supported.

entries.title: No slots were found
entries.body: Check that the Prefab contains Renderer or SkinnedMeshRenderer components and that real materials are assigned to their slots.

entries.title: Nothing to apply
entries.body: At least one scanned key must have a replacement material assigned. If every field is empty, there is nothing to write back.

entries.title: A slot was not replaced
entries.body: The tool matches against the current Material.name, not the material asset filename. Verify the actual runtime name stored in the slot.

entries.title: The scene instance does not update immediately
entries.body: This tool edits the Prefab Asset itself. If scene instances have overrides or delayed refresh, reselect the prefab or refresh the scene.
